method: TypeScript AST static literal require/import/export graph; local paths only; no module execution; runtime configs and non-code assets are not read or copied. All syntactic branches count, including CLI/test/fallback branches.
limits: Does not infer variable require paths or computed require/import expressions.
Does not traverse installed npm package dependencies or their native/prebuilt resources.
Does not enumerate fs.readFile/chokidar runtime data/config/template dependencies.
Literal optional requires and requires inside functions are included regardless of whether the branch executes.
Does not resolve require.resolve calls or createRequire invocations.
